name: Igasho's Adventure
detailed_description:
Step into a colorful world where skill-based combat meets old-school platforming adventure. As Igasho, a skilled hunter and guardian of the forest, you’ll battle to protect your homeland from ruthless poachers and the dark forces corrupting its wildlife. Guided by Manitou the Master — a wizard chimp with knowledge of ancient portal magic — you’ll uncover the truth behind the growing corruption.

Master combat through long-range shots and close-up strikes with your bow and knife. Every encounter tests your timing and strategy — whether you’re dodging twisted beasts or outwitting experienced hunters. Explore vibrant, handcrafted environments as you uncover secrets, collect treasures, and overcome platforming challenges.

Created by a solo developer with a love for classic collectathons and modern action games, this adventure rewards curiosity, skill, and exploration. From quirky characters to hidden collectibles, every corner of the world is designed to delight players who grew up with platforming legends.

Key Features:

  • Satisfying combat system blending bow and knife fighting

  • Classic platforming with modern gameplay feel

  • Mix of combat challenges and joyful exploration

  • Rich story featuring Manitou the Master, a mysterious wizard chimp who guides you through magical portals

  • Engaging narrative of protecting your homeland

  • Handcrafted world filled with secrets and collectibles

  • Unique hand-drawn art style

  • Charming cast of quirky characters

Will you rise to become the guardian the forest desperately needs?

short_description: Master bow and knife combat in this charming 3D action platformer inspired by old-school collectathons. Play as Igasho, a forest guardian hunting poachers and corrupted wildlife to restore balance to a once-peaceful land.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon RX 560 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
